summary: The agent builds a straightforward LightGBM regression pipeline with basic imputation and encoding, but omits both feature engineering and validation. A critical execution error occurs because the agent double-applies the preprocessing step, transforming the dataframe into a numpy array and then feeding it back into the same pipeline, causing a crash.
